children: The EU's planned rulebook banning under-13s from social media and imposing restrictions on services such as video games and artificial intelligence chatbots used by minors could create serious privacy and security risks, Daniel Friedlaender, senior vice president and head of office at tech lobby group CCIA Europe, says. "If this system requires large amounts of sensitive information about children, adults, and family relationships, it will create serious risks for everyone," he says. "The Commission cannot treat these as mere implementation details when key technical, privacy, and security requirements are left to subsequent implementing and delegated acts," he says. The lobby group counts tech companies such as Google and Meta as members.(edith.hancock@wsj.com)
